scripts.setup: node scripts/copy-env.js && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run prisma:deploy --prefix backend && npm run prisma:seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:e2e --prefix frontend
